primaryMetrics.initialLeakers: Unique initial ASM native NORMAL_HIT/DUD_PENETRATION or other explicitly classified native ship-contact outcome. Wreck hits are separate callbacks, not extra initial leakers.
primaryMetrics.damagingHitRounds: Each native shipHitHistory callback with dmg>0 and miss!=true, including wreck/debris callbacks. No HP clipping.
primaryMetrics.killCount: Native intercept/Phalanx/structural-failure retirement categories; raw causes preserved.
primaryMetrics.flood: Sum native flooding cell waterM3 at recorded all-initial terminal+5 end. Exact times reported, HP reference only.

statistics.primaryComparison: Across requested60 pairs, total R4 minus B initialLeakers and damagingHitRounds; two co-primary endpoints.
statistics.unit: Seed-block. First10 shared seeds includeall5 scenarios; final10 includeS6only. Preserve cross-scenario same-seed dependence.
statistics.randomization: Exact one-sided sign-flip over20 seed-block aggregate differences (2^20), greater=R4 worse. Alpha0.05 each co-primary; both must avoid worsening. Raw and Holm-adjusted p reported; unadjusted harm screening is conservative for approval.
statistics.bootstrap: 200000 paired seed-block bootstrap, independently resample the two10-block coverage strata to preserve requested case counts. Percentile95% CI for total difference; fixed diagnostic RNG seed20261102.
statistics.acceptRule: All120 valid closed runs, anchors/source checks pass. For BOTH primary endpoints: no positive significant worsening (one-sided exact p<=.05 with delta>0), and95% paired interval contains0 or lies entirely<=0. This implements user between-seed-variation rule; it is not a claim of formal noninferiority with an unspecified margin.
statistics.clearlyWorseRule: Either primary endpoint has delta>0 and one-sided exact p<=.05, or paired95% lower bound>0. Report cause and stop; no baseline updates/merge.
statistics.inconclusiveRule: Missing/invalid trials, failed anchors, or inconsistent interval/test results: no automatic approval.
statistics.secondary: Scenario-specific paired totals/distributions, exact p/CI, flood and HP descriptive; no posthoc seed exclusions or coefficient tuning.

execution.estimateBasis: Archived45s six-target pages~30–65s wall;13-target90s~40–80s with newendpoint~150–200sSIM;120freshpages two slots plus startup/export. Re-estimate from first frozen anchor pair; hard deadline enforced.
